entities.summary: Noura Ghazi, or Noura Ghazi Safadi is a Syrian human rights lawyer and activist. Her husband, the Syrian-Palestinian Bassel Khartabil, or Bassel Safadi was an open-source software developer and one of Syria's leading pro-free speech and democracy activists. He was arrested by the Syrian government in 2012 and executed in 2015.
